text: Unit 8, 8.1, 1. When the sun is out, I make sure my sun uses sunscreen so he doesn't get sunburned. 2. Have you read the information about the red planet? 3. We are having a picnic whether it is hot or not. It has been good weather recently, so we are hoping it will be nice. 4. She ate her dinner before she went out at 8 o'clock. 5. There are two doctors in the family, and their daughter is also studying medicine. 6. All a guest was in the house for an hour.
